title: Chapter 94 Lurking (For Subscription)
content:
Chapter 94 Lurking (For Subscription)

Three days after the city of Tour was broken, the leader of the Navoge tribe sent out several waves of spies. After killing hundreds of people, he finally brought back the results of the war.

The fortified city of Tours was breached, and they were led and forced by their patriarch Tucson throughout the whole process, and defended until the last moment, even women and children went to the battlefield.

And after the city was broken, the survivors in the city were all killed by the enraged enemy army, even the newly born babies were not spared.

After hearing this news, all the tribes in the southeast region lost their voices, followed by unbearable shock and fear.

Although the defenders of the entire city of Tule and the heroism of the Tucson patriarch made them admire in their hearts. But all of this does not mean that they have the determination of Tucson, who would rather do everything than fight to the end.

Therefore, when those people realized the powerful combat effectiveness of this army, they originally planned to resist and try to see if they could block the enemy's army, but they suddenly burst into cold sweat, thankful that they did not take action.

Everyone came to the Vogo Tribe, wanting to see what kind of plans the leaders of the many tribes in the southwest region have.

Everyone intends to have a discussion here to see how all the jobs in the entire southwest region think? Fortunately, according to the results of the meeting, I decided not to make the next decision!

After a while of discussion, everyone found that Wolf, the patriarch of the Vogo tribe, had not yet decided whether to surrender or not? Or stick to the end, can't help but make everyone's hearts chill!

My immediate boss didn't make a good decision. This is what we young brothers should do. It seems that the most powerful tribe in the southwest region is unreliable. Thorough strategy.

After the meeting was over, all the patriarchs rushed back to their own tribes in a hurry. Now it is the time of war, who knows if the enemy army that has rested will suddenly attack their own tribe? What should I do if I am not there at that time, and the tribe has no leader, and they are killed in one fell swoop?

After returning to their respective tribes, many patriarchs convened the elders with real power and the priests with high reputation who could communicate with the gods to discuss the choice and fate of the next tribe, which would determine the survival of the tribe in the future.

However, most of the patriarchs sent their envoys to the camp where Sun Jian's army was stationed within the next day after returning to the tribe, still communicating and contacting about the issue of surrender.

Hope to get a better treatment after the surrender, but they were frightened by the fact that Sun Jian slaughtered the entire city of Tours, and they were afraid that they would suffer the same fate. It was a matter of their own lives, so they had to be careful!

Seeing that many tribes sent envoys to his camp to discuss the matter of surrender, Sun Jian did not blame them for losing a large number of soldiers under the city of Tour.

After all, although His Majesty the Emperor had already explained before he set off on the expedition, there is no need to worry too much about losing soldiers. The point is to test out the water of the barbarians on the entire plain, how deep is it?

As long as this goal is achieved, even if you lose all your soldiers and horses, it will be meritorious. Not only will the emperor not blame him, but he will also reward him greatly.

But if Sun Jian really followed the emperor's order as an absolute golden rule, then he must have had a brain twitch, and his official career can be said to have come to an end here!

Thinking about it from another angle, the other three front armies had less battle losses than him, and only half of his own men were lost, or even the entire army was wiped out, even if he really tested how deep his barbarian water was.

Then other people also achieved the same goal, but it took longer. Although he had achieved the basic goal, but the soldiers were exhausted, what would the emperor think of him?

Will you feel that you are incompetent, and thus create a bad impression of yourself in your heart? This is a question, and you have to be careful!

At the same time, the siege under the city of Tours, the resisting will and fighting power of those barbarians completely made Sun Jian, who had some contempt for those barbarians, really build some attention and fear in his heart.

Especially the super strength shown by some of the few barbarians, the energy called Dou Qi, helped them obtain a combat power far superior to ordinary people. .

And their patriarch is even more brave, relying on his own strength alone, he can repel hundreds of people on his own side.

Although he only has such strength, it is very likely that His Majesty the Emperor mentioned to himself before the expedition, that it can only be achieved with the help of the ancestor gods worshiped by their tribe.

The outbreak is only such a short period of time, and after that, due to the consumption of the body's potential, it will completely lose its fighting power for a certain period of time.

And the Tucson patriarch was able to insist that he maintain this high-intensity strength for six days, which seemed to be determined to give up his life as a sacrifice, so as to obtain the gift of power that has always been accepted by the clan god.

At the last moment when the city was broken, he was like a god and demon. He directly killed more than 300 soldiers on his side. A fear I've never felt before.

Therefore, Sun Jian, who was frightened by the strength of these supernatural beings, was afraid that his attitude would affect these envoys, scaring them to flee back to the tribe, and advised their patriarch to resist to the death.

If I want to conquer the entire southwest region, I have to fight one by one. Not to mention the time-consuming, but also the loss of soldiers and generals, and the resistance of those tribal barbarians who can explode at any time, causing countless troubles for nothing. Why bother? ?

So for the envoys of these tribes who came to surrender, they received them very well, and expressed their goodwill to them in a kind tone, as well as the policy and treatment of their own empire to welcome them to surrender.

When all the envoys saw that other tribes had also sent people, the surprise on their faces was similar to what the hero saw. If not only one tribe was a traitor, then the pressure in their hearts would be much better.

It's like when a person is doing certain things, he feels very scared when he goes alone, but he sees his companions going along with him. Although he knows that he may be beyond his control, he will have more courage and courage for no reason. determination? Isn't that true for most creatures in the world?

So the discussion and banquet on how to surrender on this side lasted for three days, and after all the tribes who wanted the avatar gathered together, they carefully perfected and discussed carefully, and the curtain came to a perfect and harmonious conclusion.

And Sun Jian and Lu Bu, after witnessing the extraordinary power of fighting qi, had a burning desire for power in their hearts, and they also hinted at the banquet that they wanted these fighting qi cultivation techniques!

And those messengers patted their chests and said confidently, these are not problems at all, and they will definitely tell their patriarch when they go back, and use all their strength to collect those better fighting qigong methods, and hand them over to the general for cultivation .

Sun Jian, Lu Bu and others who received the affirmative reply from the envoy were delighted, but at the same time, inexplicable thoughts arose in their hearts. Something called ambition kept growing and growing in their hearts!

As for the progress of the southeast war, it seems that there is a new change in their commander's mind, but Zhong Yu is kept in the dark about all this, and he still doesn't know!
